Termination due to abandonment

Date: {{ frappe.utils.format_date(frappe.utils.nowdate(), "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}

{# Fetch Disciplinary Case #} {% set disciplinary_case = frappe.get_doc("Disciplinary Case", doc.case_id) %} {% set employee_doc = frappe.get_doc("Employee", disciplinary_case.employee_id) %} {# Fetch Reminder document safely #} {% set reminder_list = frappe.get_list( "Reminder Of Unauthorized Absence", filters={"case_id": doc.case_id}, fields=["name"], limit=1 ) %} {% if reminder_list %} {% set reminder_doc = frappe.get_doc("Reminder Of Unauthorized Absence", reminder_list[0].name) %} {% endif %}

Employee Name: {{ doc.employee_name }}

Employee ID: {{ doc.employee_id }}

Designation: {{ doc.designation }}

Branch Name: {{ doc.branch_name }}

Zone Name: {{ doc.zone_name }}

Whereas, you were appointed by Sahayog Multistate Credit Co-operative Society as per the terms and conditions of employment specifically provided in the Offer / Appointment Letter dated {{ frappe.utils.format_date(employee_doc.date_of_joining, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}.

{% if reminder_list %}

That vide this Company’s letter dated {{ frappe.utils.format_date(reminder_doc.date_of_1st_letter, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}, a show cause notice was served to you seeking explanation for your unauthorized absence since {{ frappe.utils.format_date(reminder_doc.date_of_1st_letter, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}, followed by reminder dated {{ frappe.utils.format_date(reminder_doc.date_of_reminder_letter, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}. You were also suggested to resume office immediately after receipt of the said notice. But till date, neither you resumed office nor any reply was received from your end.

{% else %}

Reminder data could not be found for this case. Please check Reminder of Unauthorized Absence document.

{% endif %}

Please be advised that the above-mentioned act of yours amounts to serious misconduct within the meaning of Human Resource Policies of the Company applicable to you. You are deemed to have abandoned duties/employment of your own accord and the Company presumes that you are no longer interested in the employment.

As a result, the Company has decided against the continuation of your services and accordingly, your services are terminated hereby with immediate effect.

For Sahayog Multistate Credit Cooperative Society

Authorized Signatory
